notes: Maintenance release: CR audit PF-S3a (#997), paired with cards v1.147.26 (nhoople/netrunner-cards-data#308). Rules behavior changes: Corporate Troubleshooter's 'this server' is the server it was in before its [trash] cost (CR 4.6.6i). Edge of World's core damage cannot be cancelled by losing clicks. Doppelgänger, Midori and Snitch are used only when their optional part is carried out, so declining keeps them (CR 9.6.9d); Snitch per copy, and its choice no longer names the unrezzed ice (CR 10.2.2a). Accelerated Beta Test may decline to look (CR 9.6.9c). Test Run chooses stack or heap and the program; a stack search may find nothing and is shuffled first (CR 8.7.2e, 8.7.3). Faerie is trashed when the encounter in which it broke ends, including by the run ending or the ice leaving (CR 6.1.4, 8.5.10). Sacrificial Construct prevents only program or hardware trashes (CR 9.9.3a). Retrieval Run may breach instead of installing from the heap. trash_program records who trashes (CR 1.14.5); Burke Bugs lets the Runner choose and does nothing with no program. Card data: Adonis Campaign places 12 credits when rezzed, Eve Campaign and Private Contracts trash when empty, Compromised Employee and Dinosaurus drop link and MU they do not print, Cortez Chip, The Helpful AI and Data Raven open in every paid ability window (CR 9.2.7b). Pins cards v1.147.26.
